original_evidence.text: | Witsy | Kochava-Studios/witsy (formerly nbonamy/witsy) | Electron (Electron Forge), uses Electron's built-in `autoUpdater` via the `update-electron-app` convention/`update.electronjs.org` service | Y | **Y** — checks immediately at startup and then every 60 minutes (`setInterval(..., 60*60*1000)`); update is downloaded automatically in the background once available; **install** requires either the user clicking "Install Update" in the tray menu or occurs automatically when the app quits (`before-quit-for-update` hook) | Y | https — feed URL `https://update.electronjs.org/Kochava-Studios/witsy/{platform}-{arch}/{version}`, which proxies to the project's GitHub Releases; delivered via Electron's native `autoUpdater` (Squirrel.Mac on macOS, Squirrel.Windows on Windows) | not an app-defined manifest; relies on the update.electronjs.org/Squirrel service's own release feed | OS-code-signing — Squirrel.Mac requires the downloaded update bundle's code signature to match the running app's signing identity before applying it; no separate hash/signature check is implemented in Witsy's own code | Apple Developer ID (macOS Squirrel) / Authenticode certificate (Windows Squirrel) — i.e. the OS/platform code-signing chain, not an app-embedded key | `src/main/autoupdate.ts:32-35` (feed URL construction, `autoUpdater.setFeedURL`); `:92-98` (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()` at startup + `setInterval(..., 60*60*1000)`); `:79-84` (`update-downloaded` event → `hooks.onUpdateAvailable`); `:122-129` (`install()` → `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`); `src/main/tray.ts:90-93` (tray "Install Update" menu item calls `autoUpdater.install`); `src/main.ts:231-237` (`new AutoUpdater(app, { onUpdateAvailable: () => trayIconManager.install() ... })`) |
